findings: OpenRig sends each seat a startup identity prompt ('run rig whoami') — seats spend tokens on orientation before any task.
Pi seats lack OPENRIG_* env: rig whoami fails; the lead self-recovered with export OPENRIG_SESSION_NAME=dev-lead@spike (works). Worker messages arrived as 'From: <unknown sender>'.
No natural stop: after the task the worker kept polling (git status, rig queue list, rig capture) — >50% of worker spend was post-completion idle. rig_swarm must tear down on lead qitem closure.
MCP rig_send from the cockpit carries no sender identity; replies route to '<unknown sender>' — read via rig_capture.
Pinned image lacks the self-compact extension (image predates it) — copied in for the spike; S1 image must bake it.
npx needs explicit bin: npx -y -p @openrig/cli@0.5.14 rig mcp serve.
